queer_characters.name: Henry Hart
queer_characters.notes: Described explicitly as a gay artist; portrayed sympathetically as the protagonist who finds love in an accepting community.

queer_characters.name: Pike Dexter
queer_characters.notes: Shown developing romantic feelings for Henry and ending the film as his partner; the text confirms his same-gender attraction but does not attach a specific label, so the queer umbrella is used.

contributor_notes: Both leads end the film happily partnered; the grandfather's death is a plot point but no queer character dies. Source highlights a rare wholly-affirming, homophobia-free rural setting. Pike is a Native American character but the text does not specify a two-spirit or other Indigenous queer identity, so none was added.
